mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO product_tag (product_id, tag_id, created_at) VALUES (UUID_TO_BIN(#{productId}), UUID_TO_BIN(#{tagId}), #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM product_tag WHERE tag_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{tagId})
DELETE FROM product_tag WHERE product_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{productId})
mapper.select: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(product_id) AS product_id, BIN_TO_UUID(tag_id) AS tag_id, created_at FROM product_tag WHERE tag_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{tagId})
SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(t.tag_id) AS tag_id, t.name, t.created_at FROM product_tag pt JOIN tag t ON pt.tag_id = t.tag_id WHERE pt.product_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{productId})
